The round-500 task is a Store round (the `/store` "Try again" link pin and button cleanup), not a Studio audio or export round. I ran its C0–C14 table. The Studio audio graph, video transport and export WAV checks from your brief were not run, because this round doesn't touch Studio. The only Studio check was C13, below.

- **Browser rows:** at 1440, 1280 and 375, all 27 mock-on and 3 mock-off rows match the sketch oracles. The two expected differences are `type="button"` on the two "Try Again" buttons, and tiny opacity noise in the press animation. Hover, keyboard focus ring, mouse-press (no ring) and contrast (8.32 / 7.06 at rest) all hold.

- **Tests and mutants:** the covering tests pass, 14 files and 138 of 138, including the new SE1 row. The old mutants N1–N4 and N6–N9 fail as expected, and N5 can't apply because its anchor changed (expected). The new mutants N5b and N10–N18 all fail on the rows B named.
- **Docs and claims:** `DESIGN_SYSTEM.md` has the two expected hunks, and doc 320 changed only on line 4. Doc 321 line 4 is byte-exact, and 11 of 11 class tokens were found in HEAD. I did not re-trace every number in the doc ledger line by line. The claims script found nothing missing (the only difference is the expected K2 count of 6 vs 5).
- **C13, premium auth:** in fresh no-credential contexts at both viewports, `/studio/1` and `/account/downloads` show "Sign in required" with no product download link. `/studio-lab` opens the demo ("no sign-in required"). Premium access is not bypassed.
